name: @whity/tokens
description: Design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, radius), fonts and logos for Whity products — generated from src/design/tokens/base.json and the brand handoff. No React/Next dependency: a plain JSON bundle, standalone importable Tailwind v4 theme CSS, a shadcn/Tailwind base-reset layer, self-hosted @font-face CSS, the websites' plain token CSS and the logo set.
